sand_sensitivity.note: Analyst-selected geometry/material sensitivities, NOT fitted QUIKRETE properties or a high-temperature wet-sand prediction. Published room-temperature sand endpoints motivate the range. A 500 C near-heater region dries; homogeneous wet k is counterfactual at that temperature.

switching_sensitivity.note: Capacities, periods and dwell times are sensitivity inputs, not measured plant parameters or approved tuning.
